    pattern = r'(class TestBaseRepr.*?def test_base_range\(self\):.*?\n(?:.*?\n)*?(?=    def |\Z))'
    def insert_test(match):
        # Find where to insert (after test_base_range ends)
        text = match.group(0)
        # Insert before the next method or at the end of class
        insert_point = len(text)
        indent = '    '
        test_code = '''\n    def test_minimal_signed_int(self):
        assert_equal(np.base_repr(np.int8(-128)), '-10000000')
'''
        return text[:insert_point] + test_code + text[insert_point:]
    # Simpler approach: find last method in TestBaseRepr and append
    lines = content.split('\n')
    insert_idx = -1
    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
        if line.startswith('class TestBaseRepr'):
            # Find the end of this class
            for j in range(i+1, len(lines)):
                if lines[j] and not lines[j][0].isspace() and lines[j][0] != ' ':
                    insert_idx = j - 1
                    break
            if insert_idx == -1:
                insert_idx = len(lines) - 1
            break
    if insert_idx > 0:
        test_lines = [
            '',
            '    def test_minimal_signed_int(self):',
            \"        assert_equal(np.base_repr(np.int8(-128)), '-10000000')\"
        ]
        for line in reversed(test_lines):
            lines.insert(insert_idx, line)
        with open('numpy/_core/tests/test_numeric.py', 'w') as f:
            f.write('\n'.join(lines))
        print('Test added')
else:
    print('Test already present')
